1. (Currently Amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keywords frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: __selecting a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud__; __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword from the data structure__; and __generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure__.

2. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to __receive a user selection of a keyword in the lexical cloud and__ display a lexical cloud and obtain a selection of a keyword in the lexical cloud.

3. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on keywords selected from __at least two sequentially generated nested lexical clouds, wherein each nested lexical cloud is generated by selecting a keyword from a preceding lexical cloud and filtering the data structure accordingly__.

4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises __at least one of: technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof__.

5. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored __in__ the storage device and to generate the plurality of keywords from the files.

6. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and a maximum display capacity__.

7. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and a maximum display capacity__.

8. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure __relative to other keywords in the temporary data structure__.

9. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure __and to rank the subset according to frequency__.

10. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud, a plurality of lower level lexical clouds, or both __dynamically__ in real time.

11. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate a list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area __and a user selection from one or more lexical clouds__.

12. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, upon __metadata derived from a measurement from a sensor or from external data sources__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud, wherein the top-level lexical cloud comprises a subset of the plurality of keywords, and wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; and generating a plurality of lower-level lexical clouds, wherein each lower-level lexical cloud is generated by: __selecting a particular keyword from the top-level lexical cloud__; eliminating any one of the plurality of items not associated with a particular one of the plurality of keywords from the data structure; and generating the lower level lexical cloud as a second subset of the plurality of keywords that remain in the data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is chosen by the overall frequency of occurrence in the data structure after elimination of any one of the plurality of items not associated with a particular one of the plurality of keywords __and is ranked according to such frequency__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, comprising displaying a list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a selection of a first keyword from the top level lexical cloud and a selection of a second keyword from __a lower level lexical cloud generated in response to the selection of the first keyword__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on __information including aesthetic descriptions provided during physical examination of the items__.

18. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: __selecting a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud__; __creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword from the data structure__; and __generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure__.

19. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to __receive a user selection of a keyword in the lexical cloud and__ display a lexical cloud and obtain a selection of a keyword from the lexical cloud.

20. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a first keyword selected from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from __a lower-level lexical cloud generated in response to the selection of the first keyword__.
